item.title: On the (un)reasonable effectiveness of self-consistency in physics
item.description: Back in 1960, Wigner wrote a famous article, The Unreasonable Effectiveness of Mathematics in the Natural Sciences to point out the amazing fact that mathematical concepts very often find applications in the natural sciences and in particular, physics.
